steps.note: the fxg login page defaults to the phone/SMS form. The QR view is behind the switcher icon at the input box's top-right corner — the in-page path, NOT the open.snssdk.com SSO detour the pre-2026-10-06 flow used. Wait for the FULL form face (switcher cell AND account-center tab pills AND an input), not just the cell: the cell renders before the account-center SDK finishes booting, and a click that early lands on a not-yet-wired element — the flip then never mounts the QR (probed 2026-10-06: settle-gated click flipped in 313ms)
viewport-pinned coords (create pins 1440x900): center of the 76x76 .login-switcher--cell. Real mouse chain via click_xy — DOM .click() on this element was never verified

the QR paints as a data: URI background-image on .account-center-image-content (200x200 css). get_qrcode on doudian-sso.jinritemai.com fires on the switch; the page then polls /passport/sso/check_qrconnect by itself — nothing to drive after handoff

the pristine handoff artifact: the QR exactly as the page holds it, zero screenshot/crop involvement (element screenshot crops misalign on scaled pages in this engine). Decode locally: strip the data: prefix, base64-decode to .gif, open it. If the QR has aged out (60-100s life), re-run the flow — the re-mint costs ~15s
human-viewable crop, same save name as the old SSO flow kept. If the crop misaligns, saved.qr_data above is the truth — verify scannability before handing either to a human

scan with the 抖店 App + confirm on the phone -> check_qrconnect returns authorized -> the page SSOs in and lands on /ffa/mshop/homepage/index. Timeout clamps to 120000ms server-side regardless of this var. While this wait is outstanding the server's other endpoints stall (flow_run holds the SESSIONS lock for the whole run — known engine bug); for a QR-handoff-then-poll pattern run with login_timeout_ms:1000, take the receipt's fresh qr_data, and poll /session/:id/wait yourself

proven 2026-10-06: landed /ffa/mshop/homepage/index 9.7s after scan confirm. Export the login state from the receipt's session_id (GET /session/:id/cookies + /storage) — cookies land on .jinritemai.com; the load-bearing names are sessionid, sessionid_ss, sid_guard, sid_tt, passport_csrf_token, toutiao_sso_user_doudian, sso_uid_tt_doudian, ucas_sso_c0_doudian, ffa_goods_ewid, ecom_gray_shop_id, odin_tt, msToken, ttwid. doudian-publish composes on this via session_id reuse
